# Draft:Ronald Edward Echols II

Ronald Edward Echols II was born on November 23,1970 and is a fulltime Dialysis Patient.
He attended Harwell Elementary School and Charles Lincoln Harper High School where he was the elected as Vice President of his senior class of 1988. He subsequently became President of the Class of 1988 with the passing of Davin Bryant. He was also voted "Most Likely to Succeed" by his graduating class. He also attended Morehouse College and the Medical College of Georgia where he obtained the degree of BSMT and became certified as a Medical Technologist. In 2007, he attended Darton College and became a Histologic Technician.
He was a Dialysis Patient from 1999-2025.
